sloka: सुव्यक्तं राजदोषो हि भविष्यति न संशयः ।पुरे जनपदे चापि ततो बालवधो ह्ययम् ।। ७.७३.१८ ॥
transliteration: suvyaktaṁ rājadoṣo hi bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ।pure janapade cāpi tato bālavadho hyayam ।। 7.73.18 ॥

translations.english: It is very clear that there will be no doubt of a king's fault in the city and the district, and therefore, this child-killing is indeed due to that.
